title: Bound Git subprocess capture and paginate status and diff output
outcome: Git read and mutation-result APIs remain usable on repositories with large status/diff/output without capturing an unbounded process stream.
acceptance: Status/diff and commit/push/sync/file-action output are bounded during subprocess capture, before String/Vec and diff-identity duplication; reuse existing Git owners.
Status and diff expose explicit totals/completeness and stable file/hunk retrieval; mutation results use bounded truthful acknowledgements with no automatic repeat of committed operations.
Existing Markdown enrichment10MiB readers and stderr budgets remain enforced; UI badges/tree/diff views no longer imply a partial result is complete.
Bounded tests cover large logical output with small limits, escapes and mutation reconciliation; independent review and full gate pass.
